newsitem.title: USA: Cytyc in 3 mln shr offering at $23.50/shr.
newsitem.headline: Cytyc in 3 mln shr offering at $23.50/shr.

text.p: Cytyc Corp said a 3.65 million shares public offering was underway at a price of $23.50 per share.

The company said it would sell 2.65 million shares and certain shareholders would sell one million shares. Underwriters were granted a 30-day option to purchase up to 547,000 additional common shares to cover over-allotments.
The offering was managed by Robertson, Stephens & Company LLC, Montgomery Securities and Piper Jaffray Inc.

Net proceeds would be used to market and sell its ThinPrep System for cervical cancer screening in the United States and to establish international marketing, sales and customer support capabilities, the company said.
Some proceeds would be used for working capital and other general corporate purposes, it said.
